verdict.rationale: The Split API automatically segments concatenated PDFs into logical document sections by content category [docs-5]. A documented example splits a multi-document PDF into separate segments using AI-powered classification [docs-37]. Classify and Extract are separate composable products under one API key and SDK [docs-4, docs-20], so per-document results are achievable, but the docs only imply this rather than show it as a single one-upload flow. Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end pipeline from one upload to per-document classified/extracted outputs, details of the per-segment result format (page ranges, labels, confidence), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
